The '''Harvest ceremony''' was a ceremony held at [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]. The [[Council of Elders (Ewok)/Legends|Ewok Elders]] allowed some [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] a journey to a location on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] where the mountains and the forest met, to harvest the special light wood the Ewoks used to make their [[Hang-glider/Legends|hang gliders]].
